entities.summary: Pyotr Ryabov (b. 1964-11-27, Podlesnaya Tavla) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Podlesnaya Tavla. Known in the fields of painters & sculptors.
